data.one_liner: Generates documentation for Flutter widgets via annotations and a preview app.
data.what_it_does: The package provides an annotation to mark widgets for documentation. A build_runner code generator creates files describing widget parameters, snippets, and metadata, which can be displayed in a preview application.
use_when: You want automatically generated docs for a library of custom widgets.
You need a quick way to preview widget usage examples without writing manual docs.
avoid_when: You prefer runtime reflection or manual documentation.
Your project cannot add a build step or extra dependencies.
strengths: Zero‑manual doc writing – generated from code.
Integrated preview UI for desktop, web, and mobile.
weaknesses: Requires build_runner and a separate builder package.
Only works for Flutter widgets, not pure Dart code.
Adds extra generated files to the repo.
data.setup_notes: Add doc_widget and doc_widget_builder to dependencies, include build_runner in dev_dependencies, then run flutter pub run build_runner build to generate docs.
